change_under_test: Backend-native erf/GELU composition, uncommitted on the base revision
diagnostic_overrides: In encoder_tensor, prefix the fused GeGLU condition with false && to select the native split/GELU/multiply composition.
In EagerSessionErfExt::{erf,gelu_erf}, temporarily replace !cpu_extensions_supported(self) with true to exercise native erf-based activation on CPU.
coverage: Production Julia input IDs, logits and action scores within the existing 2e-3 + abs(expected)*2e-5 tolerance, plus decision and system-one answer assertions.
limitations: CPU evidence only. Other model operations retain their standard CPU paths. This does not prove GPU primitive behavior, full GPU model parity, bit-identical arithmetic or latency improvement.
